name: house-committees
description: Nodes represent legislators. Each hyperedge represents a committee and contains the set of legislators serving on that committee.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., house-committees).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

nodes_metadata.label: (STRING) Political party affiliation (e.g., Democrat).
nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the legislator represented by the node (e.g., E. de la Garza).

edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Number of committee instances collapsed into this legislator-set hyperedge (e.g., 1).
